link.note: Well documented in the Dreisamtal database (GEDBAS 1262173156) as a Kageneck gamekeeper; his link to Johnny (father of Joseph Heizler of Munzingen) is probable only. Death 1806 is tree-only.

occupation: Gamekeeper and forest warden (Kageneck'scher Jäger, Waldhüter)
summary: Probable 6th great-grandfather of John; Kageneck gamekeeper and forest warden in Unteribental.
bio: Jakob Heitzler (b. c.1740) is listed in the 'Familien aus dem Dreisamtal' database as 'Kageneck'scher Jäger in Unteribental, Waldhüter' (gamekeeper and forest warden for the Counts of Kageneck); it records his role in a 1789 lawsuit and names his wife Katharina Begelspacher, whose father was also a Kageneck gamekeeper. Children recorded 1764–1781: Andreas (1764; Vogt of Unteribental 1813), Agathe (1771), Franziska (1779), Jakob (1781–1847); gaps 1765–70 and 1772–78 leave room for Joseph (b. c.1773). Tree: Jacob(us) Heitzler –1806, parents Martin(us) Heitzler 1699–1728 + Othilia Schirk –1728 (if both died 1728, a c.1740 birth is impossible — the 1728 deaths are unsupported).
openQuestions: Is Joseph Heizler of Munzingen his son? (Joseph's Munzingen death entry; Kirchzarten/Stegen baptisms c.1773)
Who were his parents — tree's Martinus Heitzler & Othilia Schirk?
